auth_retrying.title: DVR authentication retrying ({host})
auth_retrying.description:
Home Assistant received repeated authentication errors (HTTP 401/403) from the Intelbras DVR at {host}. The integration is cooling down between attempts to avoid DVR account lockout and will recover automatically once authentication succeeds.

If you changed the DVR password or user permissions, open the integration menu and select **Reconfigure** to update credentials immediately.
